[P2] Use the stable SDK type when the chain ends at an SDK error

`DurableOperationError` initializes `name` from `this.constructor.name`, which consumer minification can rename. A callback timeout therefore produces an execution name such as `"a"` here, while the new `operationErrorName()` timeout branch reports `"CallbackTimeoutError"` for the same failure. This introduces inconsistent names and leaves execution-level timeout queries unmatched. Prefer the recognized SDK `errorType` when the terminal error is an SDK error, retaining `name` for user errors, and add renamed-class or minified-bundle coverage.
